purpose: The v1 entitlement-token contract for the reference Kochergina cohort: the stable identifier chain (user_id, course_id, source payment) and what each payment kind yields. Encodes the estate's own two-layer truth, not a new system.

token_shape.group_ids: group_user rows granted by Payment::grantAccess() (course_group pivot)
token_shape.unlocked_tariff_keys: StudentController::getUserUnlockedTariffs() - tariff keys of paid payments on THIS course_id
token_shape.entitled_cohort: canonical H2164 filter: Payment paid + real (not is_conditional) + tariff not in [deposit, trial] on THIS course_id

identifier_chain: promise (offer/deposit/conditional payment) -> payment_id (paid, real) -> grantAccess() -> group_user -> lesson unlock -> first-result event

scenarios.name: deposit_does_not_entitle
scenarios.note: Deposit is a booking hold (gr61 carries one, 6000 RUB, 24-06-2026): fireOnPaid routes it to processDeposit(), which grants no groups and no course access.

scenarios.name: conditional_promise_grants_access_but_not_cohort_entitlement
scenarios.note: Promise -> access by design: grantAccess() runs for conditional payments (only emails/prana are skipped), so the learner CAN study under promise. But scopeReal() excludes the row from the cohort-entitlement filter, so cohort denominators never count promises as revenue students.

scenarios.name: cross_course_payment_leaks_nothing
scenarios.note: The H2164 fail condition: paying for cohort A must never move the token on cohort B.

revocation.action: ops revoke = refund/cancel the payment (status failed/canceled) AND detach the student from the course group (Filament); both are production actions on existing rows
revocation.expected: paid content becomes unavailable (403), lesson_user progress history stays intact, no content is deleted
